subject.title: Discord leaks internal tool-call traces (NO_REPLY, commentary, to=functions) to channel

question: Should the remaining Discord envelope-shaped internal traces be blocked in the shared outbound sanitizer or only in Discord front-channel delivery?
rationale: The boundary is security-sensitive: undermatching leaks internal tool traces to a public channel, while overmatching can hide legitimate code or JSON content.

options.title: Shared Outbound Sanitizer
options.body: Extend the shared delivery sanitizer for known internal envelope shapes and require cross-channel false-positive tests before relying on channel adapters.

options.title: Discord-Only Guard
options.body: Keep the broader stripping logic in Discord reply/send delivery and prove sibling channels are not exposed to the same envelope shapes.

options.title: Fold Into #25592
options.body: Treat this as a Discord-specific satellite of the broader channel text-leak policy issue and close only after that canonical design lands.

recommendation.title: Shared Outbound Sanitizer
recommendation.body: Extend the shared delivery sanitizer for known internal envelope shapes and require cross-channel false-positive tests before relying on channel adapters.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the most directly overlapping merged sanitizer work on Discord reply-safety and shared assistant-visible stripping.
